Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.paymentexecution

Interface KfeExecutionOutboxRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>
@Repository public interface KfeExecutionOutboxRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity,UUID>
Queries and atomically claims asynchronous payment execution commands for workers.

The locking reads protect transaction state during reconciliation. Candidate queries include due work, recoverable unknown outcomes, and expired worker leases. Claim operations are compare-and-set updates; heartbeat succeeds only for an active matching token and unexpired lease, so update counts signal whether worker ownership remains valid.

    • findTop100ClaimCandidates

      @Query("select o from KfeExecutionOutboxEntity o\nwhere (\n o.status in :dueStatuses\n and (o.nextAttemptAt is null or o.nextAttemptAt <= :now)\n) or (\n o.status = \'UNKNOWN\'\n and o.operation in :recoverableOperations\n and o.nextAttemptAt is not null and o.nextAttemptAt <= :now\n) or (\n o.status = \'PROCESSING\'\n and (\n o.leaseExpiresAt is null\n or o.leaseExpiresAt <= :now\n )\n)\norder by o.createdAt asc, o.id asc\n") List<KfeExecutionOutboxEntity> findTop100ClaimCandidates(@Param("dueStatuses") Collection<String> dueStatuses, @Param("recoverableOperations") Collection<String> recoverableOperations, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Selects due commands, due recoverable unknown outcomes, and expired processing leases.
      Parameters:
      dueStatuses - command states eligible for a retry or first attempt
      recoverableOperations - operation names for which unknown outcomes can be reconciled
      now - current UTC time used to evaluate attempt and lease deadlines
      pageable - worker batch window
      Returns:
      candidates ordered oldest first with UUID as a stable tie-breaker

    • claimDue

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeExecutionOutboxEntity o\nset o.status = \'PROCESSING\',\n o.claimedBy = :workerId,\n o.claimedAt = :now,\n o.claimToken = :claimToken,\n o.leaseExpiresAt = :leaseExpiresAt,\n o.updatedAt = :now,\n o.rowVersion = o.rowVersion + 1\nwhere o.id = :id\n and (\n (\n o.status in :dueStatuses\n and (o.nextAttemptAt is null or o.nextAttemptAt <= :now)\n ) or (\n o.status = \'UNKNOWN\'\n and o.operation in :recoverableOperations\n and o.nextAttemptAt is not null and o.nextAttemptAt <= :now\n ) or (\n o.status = \'PROCESSING\'\n and (\n o.leaseExpiresAt is null\n or o.leaseExpiresAt <= :now\n )\n )\n )\n") int claimDue(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("dueStatuses") Collection<String> dueStatuses, @Param("recoverableOperations") Collection<String> recoverableOperations, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("workerId") String workerId, @Param("claimToken") UUID claimToken, @Param("leaseExpiresAt") LocalDateTime leaseExpiresAt)
      Claims one eligible execution command, assigning worker, token, and lease atomically.
      Parameters:
      id - command row UUID
      dueStatuses - retry/initial states eligible for processing
      recoverableOperations - operation names allowed to resume from unknown status
      now - current UTC instant used by eligibility checks and claim timestamp
      workerId - worker taking ownership
      claimToken - fresh fencing token required for subsequent heartbeat
      leaseExpiresAt - UTC expiry for the acquired lease
      Returns:
      one when the compare-and-set claim succeeds, otherwise zero

    • claimImmediate

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeExecutionOutboxEntity o\nset o.status = \'PROCESSING\',\n o.claimedBy = :workerId,\n o.claimedAt = :now,\n o.claimToken = :claimToken,\n o.leaseExpiresAt = :leaseExpiresAt,\n o.updatedAt = :now,\n o.rowVersion = o.rowVersion + 1\nwhere o.id = :id\n and o.status in (\'PENDING\', \'FAILED_RETRYABLE\')\n and (o.nextAttemptAt is null or o.nextAttemptAt <= :now)\n") int claimImmediate(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("workerId") String workerId, @Param("claimToken") UUID claimToken, @Param("leaseExpiresAt") LocalDateTime leaseExpiresAt)
      Claims a due pending or retryable row for immediate synchronous-on-submit processing.

      The restricted source states keep this fast path from taking over work already claimed by an asynchronous worker.

      Parameters:
      id - command row UUID
      now - UTC claim time and retry eligibility reference
      workerId - identity assigned to the synchronous claimant
      claimToken - fresh fencing token for later updates
      leaseExpiresAt - UTC lease deadline
      Returns:
      one if immediate claim succeeded, otherwise zero

    • heartbeat

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeExecutionOutboxEntity o\nset o.leaseExpiresAt = :leaseExpiresAt,\n o.updatedAt = :now,\n o.rowVersion = o.rowVersion + 1\nwhere o.id = :id\n and o.status = \'PROCESSING\'\n and o.claimToken = :claimToken\n and o.leaseExpiresAt > :now\n") int heartbeat(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("claimToken") UUID claimToken, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("leaseExpiresAt") LocalDateTime leaseExpiresAt)
      Extends an active processing lease only for its current unexpired fencing token.
      Parameters:
      id - command row UUID
      claimToken - token assigned to the current claimant
      now - current UTC instant; an expired claim cannot be renewed
      leaseExpiresAt - new UTC lease expiry
      Returns:
      one when the matching live lease was renewed, otherwise zero
